sloka: तेन खड्गप्रहारेण रक्षसा बलिना हतः।मुहूर्तमभवद्वीरो विसञ्ज्ञ इव वानरः ।। ६.९७.२४ ।।
transliteration: tena khaḍgaprahāreṇa rakṣasā balinā hataḥ।muhūrtamabhavadvīro visañjña iva vānaraḥ ।। 6.97.24 ।।

translations.english: Struck by the mighty Rakshasa with a sword, the Vanara leader, a heroic one, got wounded, and became unconscious for a while.
